body:
PR-2808 (STORY-1843 PR1) at e85d432eba: CI is RED because of this PR, so it isn't reviewable yet.
Failing: CI (cli-0) aida-cli/tests/task_1717_store_writer_lock.rs:1384 local_mailbox_send_never_waits_for_the_store
  stderr: "send refused: unknown recipient 'bob'; choose a live handle from `aida agent ls` or a known person"
That's the intended C1 behaviour. Fix the TEST, not the refusal: have the fixture send to a recipient the resolver accepts (a known person or roster entry the fixture seeds), while keeping the test's point: local send completes while the store lock is held and writes nothing canonical. Then grep the other test suites for sends to made-up recipients (rg -n '"--to", "' aida-cli/tests) and fix any similar breaks in the same commit; CI only showed the first failure in that shard.
Also: STORY-1890 (the review-request spec you filed) is superseded into STORY-1843. No need to file review-request specs; mail the advisor "READY: #2808 at <sha>" once CI is green and I'll dispatch the independent review.
Gates: make check-ci-fast plus make test-touched (also run the task_1717 test file). New commit, no force-push.
subject: PR-2808 CI red: unknown-recipient test fixture
